summary: Attempt 3 does what the send-back asked and leaves the product code alone. Tests already existed for 14 of the 15 temp-tree case obligations, but the 20-entry cap on the cases list meant attempt 2 never linked them. This attempt links each owed case key (C-001…C-027) to the test that feeds that shape. I also strengthened C-015's test so it covers the store's parent as the root, and added two judge Facts that run on hand-written run logs: C-011 (a boot that has already walked the layer gives VOID) and C-027 (missing or null inputs give UNDECIDED, and a burst gap is left out of drift). Writing those Facts exposed a real gap in PoolWatch -Report: a null 0x120089 handle reading (class 64) was skipped without a word. It now gives UNDECIDED. -Report also prints a separate FILTERS line, which reads UNDECIDED when no `fltmc filters` paste was supplied. For O-023, rule 1 now flags any Layers path segment in a literal, and the elevation rule now covers every file under tests/window, with an added C# `Verb = "runas"` pattern. Three new plants (S27–S29) cover the gaps the old patterns missed. The full harness gives 84 AS-RECORDED, 0 stray hits, exit 0.

files.why: O-023: rule 'only ContainerLayerStore composes the container layer store path' gains '(?m)(?i:["\\/]Layers(?=["\\/]))', which flags a Layers path segment in any literal, so a store path built across calls is caught. 'the pool measurement never needs elevation' widens from tests/window/PoolWatch*.ps1 to tests/window/** and gains a C# Verb = "runas" pattern. Its patterns stay (?im).

O-023 plants. S27: a store built as containers + @"\layers\" fires only on the new segment pattern. S28: RunAs on line 3 of a protocol script that is not PoolWatch.ps1. S29: Verb="runas" in the ScanArm C# rig. S18 now also expects the segment pattern (also_settled), so it is not a stray hit.

C-027/review m7: -Report now gives UNDECIDED when an arm's or the closing control's 0x120089 handle reading is null; before, it skipped the handle clause without saying so. New Get-FiltersLine prints 'FILTERS recorded' or 'FILTERS UNDECIDED' for the fltmc paste, apart from the pool verdict, and writes it to result.txt.

C-011: ARunOnABootThatAlreadyWalkedTheLayerIsVoidNeverPass. Adds the handles-null scenario and a shared Judge helper.

C-015: with the root at the store's parent, TheStoreAsATopLevelRowIsNotScannedNeitherDoneNorUnreadable now asserts all of these: the store is an entry flagged NotScanned and not Unreadable; it has 0 children; it was never listed (AfterFolder); it is the single SkippedStores entry; Unreadable is empty; OpensUnderExcludedStore is 0; its sibling is still listed.
Records -Report's FILTERS line, and that a null class 64 handle count gives UNDECIDED in the tolerance row's routing table.

obligations.how: C-001 is linked to the committed repro SL095.ContainerLayerWalk.Tests.ContainerLayerWalkTests.AScanOfTheContainerStoreDoesNotWalkIntoTheLiveLayersFiles. It roots at the real C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows\Containers with the live layer 1f35079a beneath it. Re-run this attempt: 1 passed, exit 0.

C-002 is linked to ContainerLayerStoreTests.ARootAtOrInsideTheStoreIsRefused. Its "" row roots at the planted store itself. Per Q-179/Q-182 the outcome is Refused, with 0 guard calls, an empty store, and SkippedStores empty. Nothing is skipped wholesale and nothing is walked.
C-003 is linked to ARootAtOrInsideTheStoreIsRefused's row \L1\Files\Windows\System32\Speech, a root deep under the store. It is refused with 0 opens, so the spike's '3 empty folders' cannot occur.

C-004 is linked to ARootAboveTheStoreInAnotherSpellingStillStopsAtIt. Its rows are extended (\\?\), lower, upper and trailing-separator. Every popped path carries that spelling, and each row ends with exactly one SkippedStores entry, totals without the store, and 0 opens under it.

C-005 is linked to FoldersNamedLikeTheStoreElsewhereOrBesideItAreCounted. The tree has a\Layers, plus Containers\Layers2 and Containers\LayersBackup beside the store. All three are walked and counted (+700 B), and only the store is skipped.

C-006 is linked to WithNoStoreTheScanIsWhatItWasBefore. The override names a missing store. The result matches the precaution-off scan in totals, entry count and unreadable count, SkippedStores is empty, and OpensUnderExcludedStore is 0. The report and panel derive from exactly those fields.

C-007 is linked to AnEmptyKnownFolderMeansNoStoreNeverEveryPath. Locate(""/null/whitespace/relative) gives null. With override "", "  " or "relative", Resolve gives None and the scan counts everything, store bytes included, with SkippedStores empty. An empty prefix never matches every path.

C-008 is linked to TheStoreAsItsParentsLastPendingFolderLetsTheRowFinish. The store is the only, and so the last, pending folder of Containers. The scan completes, the x row settles Done, totals are right, and AfterFolder fires 3 times (root, x, Containers), never for Layers.

C-011 is linked to a new Fact, PoolWatchReportTests.ARunOnABootThatAlreadyWalkedTheLayerIsVoidNeverPass. -Report runs on generated logs. With R0 7200 s after boot it gives VOID with the boot-age reason. With a closing control that leaks 0 WCsc it gives VOID with the not-armable reason. Neither gives VERDICT PASS. The current design's threshold is 30 min; the fed 2 h is over both it and the 15 min in the case text.

Rule 1 (only ContainerLayerStore composes…) already caught forward slashes and now also flags any Layers path segment in a literal ('(?m)(?i:["\\/]Layers(?=["\\/]))'), which catches containers + @"\layers\". Rule 2 (never needs elevation) keeps its line-by-line (?im) patterns and now covers tests/window/**, every protocol script and rig, with a C# Verb="runas" pattern added. Plants S27, S28 and S29 cover the three gaps the old patterns missed; S15 (fltmc on line 2) and S19 (forward slashes) already existed. harness.py --scenario all: 84 AS-RECORDED, 0 stray, exit 0, clean baseline 0 hits. A Select-String over all 304 files under tests/window, ignored ones included, and over src finds 0 hits for the widened patterns.

C-015: TheStoreAsATopLevelRowIsNotScannedNeitherDoneNorUnreadable roots at the planted store's parent (x\Containers) and now asserts the full contract. The store is an entry and a NotScanned row with 0 bytes and 0 children. It was never listed. It is the single SkippedStores entry. It is not Unreadable and Unreadable is empty. OpensUnderExcludedStore is 0. ContainerStorages is still listed.

C-016 is linked to ARootAtOrInsideTheStoreIsRefused (the store, a layer folder, and a deep folder). The case text expected 'walked fully'. Q-179/Q-182, answered after it, decided Refuse, so the built outcome is Refused, nothing opened, and SkippedStores empty. The rule never goes active against a root inside the store.

C-017 is linked to FoldersNamedLikeTheStoreElsewhereOrBesideItAreCounted. The store's sibling Containers\Layers2 (and LayersBackup) is walked and its 200 B are counted, so the separator boundary holds.

C-020 is linked to ARootSpelledWithTheVolumeGuidStopsAtTheStore. The root is \\?\Volume{GUID}\…\x for the temp tree's volume. The handle step rebases the store into that spelling: exactly one SkippedStores entry, totals 15 B, 0 opens under the store. The test existed but was unlinked.

C-021 is linked to ARootAboveTheStoreInAnotherSpellingStillStopsAtIt, whose 'lower' row lower-cases the root, so popped names arrive in on-disk case under a lower-case prefix. The case-insensitive compare still stops at the store.

C-022 is linked to AStoreBeyondMaxPathIsStillLeftOut. The planted store sits under 10 nested folders, past 260 characters (asserted), so popped paths carry \\?\. It is still left out: totals 9 B and one SkippedStores entry at that path. The test existed but was unlinked.

C-024 is linked to WithNoStoreTheScanIsWhatItWasBefore: no-op rule, totals unchanged, SkippedStores empty. The two SKIPPED requirements are already in the tree. The bug test's LiveLayerFactAttribute sets Skip with the reason when there is no layer. WindowCases X-001/X-002 fail with 'SKIPPED: this PC has no Windows container layer store…' rather than pass.

C-027 is linked to a new Fact, PoolWatchReportTests.MissingOrNullReadingsAreUndecidedAndABurstGapIsLeftOutOfDrift. A missing L/settled mark, null tags, and a null class 64 handle count each give OUTCOME UNDECIDED with the reason, never PASS; the handle case needed the -Report fix built this attempt. A missing fltmc paste gives 'FILTERS UNDECIDED', never 'recorded', and a pasted fltmc.txt gives 'recorded'. A 300 MiB burst gap in I0 is left out of drift: result.json driftPagedPerSec is about 0, and the run reads A/PASS.

architecture.find: It records every folder it could not open instead of dropping it silently.
architecture.replace: It records every folder it could not open instead of dropping it silently. It never opens the Windows container layer store (%ProgramData%\Microsoft\Windows\Containers\Layers), which it matches by path once per scan. A scan above the store records it as one folder not scanned, its size not counted and kept apart from the unreadable folders. A root at or inside the store is refused with nothing read. This holds while the precaution against wcifs.sys's leak (microsoft/Windows-Containers#646) is on, as it is unless the person turns it off.

deviations: O-005/O-006/O-030 (cases C-002, C-003, C-016) come from an earlier design. That design expected a root at or inside the store to be 'walked fully, SkippedStores empty'. Q-179 and Q-182 were answered later and decided Refuse, so the linked test feeds the same shapes and expects Refused: 0 opens, SkippedStores empty. The person's newer decision wins over the older case text.

O-014 (C-011) says 'uptime over 15 min'. The current design (X4, PoolWatch contract) sets VOID at R0 more than 30 min after the boot. The test feeds 2 h, which is over both. A run whose R0 falls 15 to 30 min after boot is accepted, as the current design says.

O-041 (C-027) names 'a null fltmc paste' among the missing data. The fltmc paste is criterion 3's filter list, not an input of DONE (c)'s pool verdict. So it is judged on a separate FILTERS line that reads UNDECIDED and never 'recorded'. It does not force the pool VERDICT off PASS: a person-optional, admin-only paste must not block DONE (c). A null class 64 handle count does make the verdict UNDECIDED.

O-023: the send-back asked that rule 2 cover 'every protocol script under tests/window'. It now covers every file under tests/window, the C# rigs included, with an added C# Verb="runas" pattern. That is slightly wider than PowerShell scripts only. Nothing under tests/window or src hits the widened rules (0 of 304 files).
not_built: The person-run protocol that DONE (c) needs. It is -Prepare on the pre-Restart boot, then Start > Restart, then -Protocol within 30 min (about 4 h), plus a second session only if L is over T (Q-184, Q-185). A Restart is the person's action. Run logs go under docs/design/SL-095-runs/.
fltmc filters output. It needs an administrator, and the design makes it a person's paste into fltmc.txt. -Report now says FILTERS UNDECIDED until that paste exists.
-Prepare's pressure positive control and its WinSxS trigger checks were not run here, as the send-back required (build attempt 1 was stopped at +0.54 GB). Both are built.
The optional Shut down leg in -Prepare (N4): allowed by the decision, not required.
Brief step 3's switch-one-behaviour-off narrowing of SC-070/074 and SC-067. The design leaves those unchanged; the protocol's S/P split and the cancelled runs cover SC-011 and SC-017.
follow_ups: Why this rebuild happened, which is not a scanner loop: build attempt 2 had tests for every one of these cases, but the cases list's cap of 20 entries was below the 68 obligations it was handed, so 17 cases went unlinked. This attempt changes no src. If a slice is handed more case obligations than the cap allows, it needs either a larger cap or a way to link several keys to one test.

.taad/fitness.yaml carries three overlapping SL-095 store-spelling rules, appended by three design laps ('only ContainerLayerStore composes…', '…composed in one place', '…spelled in one place'). Consolidating them into one rule with all four patterns would simplify the plants' also_settled lists.

-Prepare and -Environment read fltmc.txt only from their own run folder; -Prepare's is <RunDir>\prepare. -Report's FILTERS line checks both the session folder and its prepare folder. The person's instructions should name one place.

The person runs `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests\window\PoolWatch.ps1 -Prepare`, then Start > Restart, then -Protocol within 30 min, then commits docs/design/SL-095-runs/session-1.
Delete tests/window/ScanArm and the InternalsVisibleTo ScanArm line once O-003's outcome is recorded (stack decision).

The 3 failures that predate this slice need their own slice: LastAccessTests.AFolderThatRefusesWriteAttributesIsListedPlainlyAndCountedInFull, HeldOpenTreeTests.TheScanChangesNoEntrysMetadata and APlainListingOfTheControlFolderMovesItsLastAccessTime (DisableLastAccess=2).
A hook mode that drives the Precautions dialog (untick, confirm) on a temp tree, so the switch's off position is exercised through the published exe without touching the real store.
